Unfortunately, no. The Moon’s center is about **51.9° below the horizon**, so it is geometrically impossible to see from Perth at that time, regardless of the clear, dark sky.

Its small illumination and proximity to the Sun would make it a thin waning crescent, but those factors are secondary—the Moon simply has not risen yet. You would need to wait until the pre-dawn hours, near moonrise, for a chance to spot it.
